description: Test class for DefaultNotesRepository, verifying CRUD operations, synchronization, reactive observation, and search functionality within the Note Organizer application.

classes.name: DefaultNotesRepositorySyncAndCrudTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing CRUD, sync, and reactive functionalities of DefaultNotesRepository.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes in-memory database, API mock, and repository before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes database connection after each test.

methods.name: crud_create_update_delete_are_reflected_in_observeNote_and_observeNotes
methods.description: Tests CRUD operations' reflection in observation streams.

methods.name: offline_persistence_room_keeps_data_across_repository_instances
methods.description: Verifies data persistence across repository instances.

methods.name: sync_uploads_dirty_items_and_marks_clean
methods.description: Tests that sync uploads dirty notes and marks them as clean locally.

methods.name: sync_last_write_wins_does_not_overwrite_local_when_local_is_newer_than_remote
methods.description: Ensures local updates with newer timestamps are not overwritten by older remote data during sync.

methods.name: sync_tombstone_deletion_is_uploaded_and_purged_locally_and_visible_to_remote
methods.description: Validates proper handling of note deletions via tombstones during sync.

methods.name: search_escapes_like_wildcards_percent_and_underscore
methods.description: Checks that search queries correctly escape SQL wildcards.

methods.name: observeNotes_is_reactive_emits_when_item_changes_to_match_filter
methods.description: Verifies reactive emission of note list updates when data changes to match search query.
